content.text: There will be a prize at Open Repositories for the first implementation of the model described in:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eYlJH81dSiw
For example, here's a script that creates a binary that ldp:contains itself:
https://gist.github.com/escowles/08452c164446dd878970269379ea2409

Is this explicitly against the LDP spec? I'm not asking because I think this is just fine and we needn't do anything about it (although I don't think it's actually all that problematic-- I can think of (admittedly obscure) use cases for recursive constructions). I'm asking because if it isn't, then a sub-issue here is to work with the LDP editors to get this marked out in the spec as it goes forward.
It's not explicitly an error according to the spec, it's just wrong in Fedora4. The NonRDFSource in Esme's example clearly does not contain itself.
So there are two issues here: do what we need to do with Fedora, and work with LDP to clarify the spec going forward.
, do you want to break these up? I feel like they are pretty different sorts of tasks.
The conversation with the LDP community has already been started:
https://lists.w3.org/Archives/Public/public-ldpnext/2016Apr/0000.html
It seems useful, assuming we all agree, to use this ticket for the Fedora implementation restriction on the use of
ldp:contains
Yes, that's what I understand this ticket to be. I would like a separate ticket for the other piece of the puzzle. Much as I appreciate
taking on that discussion, it would have been nice to know that it had happened at all.
Thanks,
. Please create and link the "separate ticket" to this current ticket when you have a moment.
, please add the "Task" issue type to the Jira config for this project.
Hello

, the "Task" issue type does not work very well with the Scrum Board and sprints in that sub-tasks render in a different row than the other tickets and we are unable to close a sprint if an issue has some completed and some outstanding sub-tasks.
Would you be amenable to creating the new ticket as either a "Documentation" or "Improvement" type, and simply linking the two tickets together?
, Assuming you removed your name from the 'assignee' intentionally, can you please move the state of this ticket out of "In Progress"?
Resolved by:
https://jira.duraspace.org/browse/FCREPO-2899

If you set up a Direct or Indirect Container, with a memberRelation of ldp:contains, then F4 will happily go ahead and add the triple to the membershipResource.  As everything is a Container, you can mess with consistency in a horrible way with this, resulting in children with multiple parents.
